summary.taskName: Verify pending team requests list functionality

test_plan.objective: Verify the manager pending requests list renders correctly, shows accurate employee and leave details, displays empty state when no pending requests exist, shows the action count badge, and loads within the 2-second performance threshold.

in_scope: Pending Approvals section renders on manager dashboard
Action count badge shows correct number
Each request card shows employee name, leave type badge, dates, total days, and reason
Approve and Reject buttons are present per request
Empty state 'All caught up!' shown when no pending requests
Response time under 2 seconds from navigation to content render
out_of_scope: Approve/Reject action workflow (covered in separate task 3209)

entry_criteria: At least one employee with a PENDING leave request assigned to the manager
risks: Manager user must have pending requests from their team — seed data required if none exist

test_cases.title: Manager dashboard renders Pending Approvals section
test_cases.expected_result: Pending Approvals heading is present in the manager dashboard.

test_cases.title: Action count badge shows correct pending count
steps: Wait for pending requests list to load (data-testid='pending-requests-list')
Count request cards in the list
Assert badge text matches count (e.g. '2 Actions Needed')
test_cases.expected_result: Badge count equals the number of visible request cards.

test_cases.title: Each request card displays employee name, leave type, dates, days, and reason
preconditions: At least one pending request exists
steps: For the first card, assert: employee name (h4), leave type badge (span.bg-blue-100), date range text, total_days text, and reason italic paragraph
test_cases.expected_result: All required fields are rendered in the first request card.

test_cases.title: Approve and Reject buttons present for each pending request
preconditions: At least one pending request exists
steps: Assert first card has an Approve button (aria-label contains 'Approve')
Assert first card has a Reject button (aria-label contains 'Reject')
test_cases.expected_result: Both Approve and Reject buttons are visible per pending request card.

test_cases.title: Empty state shown when no pending requests exist
preconditions: No pending requests in the manager's team
steps: Wait for page to finish loading (skeleton gone)
If empty state present: assert data-testid='empty-state' is visible
test_cases.expected_result: Empty state card with 'All caught up!' and description is shown.

test_cases.title: Pending requests list loads within 2 seconds
steps: Wait for either pending-requests-list or empty-state to appear
test_cases.expected_result: Content renders within 2 seconds of navigation.

test_cases.title: Employee user cannot access manager dashboard (RBAC)
steps: Assert redirect to /dashboard/employee or access denied
test_cases.expected_result: Employee is redirected away from the manager dashboard.
